title: Pre-registered predictions for hardware tests
description: Written before any capture. tools/runtime_capture.py evaluates each prediction and may only return a declared outcome id. A prediction is not an observation, and a matching outcome does not prove every assumption behind it.

basis.description: Where the expected outcome comes from.

resolvable_by_v3.description: Whether an after-boot Linux capture can answer the question at all.

confidence.description: Confidence in the basis of the expected outcome, not in any hardware result.

class.description: expected: what the reconstruction predicts; alternative: a pre-registered competing explanation; unexpected: contradicts the reconstruction; insufficient: missing information, never a negative result; review: needs a human.
